text: The Aventro Zoom is a versatile and robust SUV, perfect for families and adventure-lovers alike. It offers a dynamic blend of performance, comfort, and next-generation technology, making it a top contender in its segment. Zoom is available in four powertrains—Petrol, Diesel, Electric, and Hybrid—with three trim levels each: Base, X, and ZX.
